user_saw: After rerunning QuickStart onboarding, an operator whose Gateway used trusted-proxy authentication was prompted for a token instead of being signed in through the proxy.
summary: The fix preserves trusted-proxy authentication and its configured password across setup reruns and binds post-setup health checks to the selected local Gateway.
reasoning: QuickStart carried forward only explicit token or password modes, so a trusted-proxy config without a stored secret fell through to token and onboarding persisted that mode. The July 5 refactor moved the same condition out of the classic wizard, and the older path history stopped at a missing parent, leaving the introducing commit and any earlier working behavior unverified.
